svg.text: How I built ContractIQ, an AI contract-review app, with Claude Code: from idea to live URL
Write the docs before any code
Fork and clone the starter repo,
then open it in VS Code
Read the PRD, the design system and
Create a Supabase project and add
Have the spec agent turn the doc
Cite the source in every answer
Lean calls that send only the

Two side builds on the same contract
Contract fields extracted the same way every run, saved by a tool, and
Turn a document into a graph
Party → PARTY_TO → Contract → CONTAINS → Clause, which you can query
An agent is the engineer; a skill is the playbook it follows
It holds the stage, the rules, and what Claude may do
@file references to the PRD, docs and skills
Never put a secret behind it
